offers.name: Report & Pitch Studio
offers.scope: A source-linked decision brief, transparent calculations and an editable presentation.
offers.review_boundary: Editorial interpretation, recommendations and publication require review.

offers.name: Article Publication
offers.scope: An attributed article draft retaining the qualifications in supplied source records.
offers.review_boundary: Editorial review, rights and reference authenticity remain to be confirmed.

offers.name: Article Publication Studio
offers.scope: A publication-preparation example from the shared article production pathway.
offers.review_boundary: This shares its article capability with Article Publication; it is not a separate expert endorsement.

offers.name: Professional Correspondence
offers.scope: A specific factual letter requesting the records needed for reconciliation.
offers.review_boundary: The sender approves tone, position and commitments before sending.

offers.name: Professional Correspondence Studio
offers.scope: An editable correspondence preparation service with source-linked facts.
offers.review_boundary: This Studio uses the shared correspondence capability. Sending remains a separate decision.

offers.name: Contract Desk
offers.scope: A clause register, obligation candidates, dated review calendar and questions for the contract owner.
offers.review_boundary: This is contract administration preparation. Legal meaning, dates and enforceability require qualified review.

offers.name: Finance Readiness
offers.scope: A requirement-to-evidence review, missing-document requests and transparent financial calculations.
offers.review_boundary: An accountant, lender or responsible reviewer confirms the records and conclusions. No lending decision is made.

offers.name: Finance Readiness Studio
offers.scope: A finance-readiness example showing how changed source amounts change the calculations.
offers.review_boundary: This Studio shares the finance-readiness capability. No affordability, valuation or lending approval is issued.

offers.name: FundingFinder
offers.scope: An applicant-specific shortlist with criterion evidence, timing checks and next-document requests.
offers.review_boundary: This example uses a fictional funding programme. Actual current windows and eligibility must be confirmed with the funder.

offers.name: Launch Studio
offers.scope: A source-bound launch kit with channel-specific creatives, copy, a landing page and an owner schedule.
offers.review_boundary: The customer brand in this example is fictional. Claims, rights, destinations, publication and spend need owner review.

offers.name: Evidex EvidenceOps
offers.scope: A claim-to-record review highlighting a reported quantity discrepancy and the underlying records still needed.
offers.review_boundary: Capturing a statement does not independently verify it. Records, period and population need reconciliation.

offers.name: VAMP Performance
offers.scope: A January-June performance evidence review with real objective mapping, candidates and documentary gaps.
offers.review_boundary: This is evidence preparation for a performance conversation. It creates no employee rating, promotion decision or CPD award.
